title: Book Three · Chapter 199: The Sunday Ticket
story:
Before Ronan's departure, Mum and Dad hold their July household review.

Dad puts in twelve yuan and Mum eight. The parents' study envelope now holds three hundred and forty.

With Ronan's five hundred and ten and his older twenty and a half, the saved total is eight hundred and seventy and a half.

Mum brings the envelope from beside the household book. Dad counts the money with Ronan. Then Mum puts it in her son's hands.

“For the study we planned,” she says.

Ronan thanks them. He keeps that three hundred and forty separate from his own two envelopes.

The next afternoon, he takes the arrival sheet to the station.

His class begins on the last Monday in July. He needs the Sunday bus before that Monday.

The woman checks the date in her book.

“Seven in the morning,” she says. “About eight hours. You should reach the city around three.”

“Still twenty yuan?”

“Twenty.”

He buys the single ticket from his work money. That part of his savings becomes four hundred and ninety. All three envelopes now hold eight hundred and fifty and a half.

Outside, he checks the ticket against the printed class date. The bus day is right.

He reads the centre's final arrival instructions again. The Sunday desk is open from two until six. It handles registration, room keys, and the first term's payment.

The local bus still costs one yuan. Its journey from the station takes about twenty minutes. The route sheet says two local buses run each hour until seven in the evening. There is a short walk from the stop to the centre gate.

Ronan puts the route beside the ticket. There is time to wait for the local bus and still reach the desk before six.

At home, he shows the papers to Dad.

“A long morning,” Dad says.

“And afternoon.”

Mum looks at the seven o'clock departure.

“We will walk to the station early.”

Ronan nods and puts the ticket in his cloth case. The office papers go in one pocket. Anna's private letter stays in the other.

After dinner, he takes the three money envelopes to the travel bag's inside pocket. The class and room fee is still unpaid. He will take it to the office himself.

Before he closes the bag, he checks the ticket once more. Then he goes outside to sit with Mum and Dad in the last of the evening light.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

single ticket＝单程票；registration＝报到登记；instruction＝具体说明；departure＝出发。

## 理解问题

1. 父母怎样实际把教育款交给Ronan？七月实存和买二十元票后，三份各多少？
2. 七点出发、八小时车程与周日十四至十八点报到怎样衔接？首二百四十元已付了吗？

## 读句子

**The bus day is right.**

拆开看：The bus day / is / right.

票上乘车的日期／与报到安排／相符。
